name: o2o-platform
description: Gộp chung Admin Server + Admin Web (mới) với Client Server + Client Web (repo Touch-app có sẵn của bạn) để chạy npm run dev 1 lệnh duy nhất.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n ADMIN-BE,ADMIN-FE,CLIENT-BE,CLIENT-FE -c blue,cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix admin-server" "npm run dev --prefix admin-web" "npm run dev --prefix client-server" "npm run dev --prefix client-web"
scripts.dev:admin: concurrently -n ADMIN-BE,ADMIN-FE -c blue,cyan "npm run dev --prefix admin-server" "npm run dev --prefix admin-web"
scripts.dev:client: concurrently -n CLIENT-BE,CLIENT-FE -c magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix client-server" "npm run dev --prefix client-web"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix admin-server && npm install --prefix admin-web && npm install --prefix client-server && npm install --prefix client-web
